run_kuka_simulation: run the kuka gym environment simulation with interactive debug parameter sliders for robot control
create_kuka_environment: create a KukaGymEnv instance with renders enabled and discrete action space disabled
add_debug_parameter: add a user debug parameter slider to control robot position or yaw values
step_simulation: step the kuka environment forward with an action list and retrieve state and reward
read_debug_parameter: read the current value of a user debug parameter slider for robot control
